comments.author: InclinedPlane
comments.story: Forgotten audio formats: The Highway Hi-Fi
comments.why: Coolest obscure format covered, a tape loop with grooves.
comments.text: The coolest thing he's covered, I think, that I'd never heard of before is the tefifon: [VIDEO] It's basically a continuous loop of tape (similar to an 8-track) but with groves recording music (like a vinyl record). It didn't see much popularity outside of Germany and then was essentially obsoleted by magnetic tape. Such a fascinating technology though. In a parallel Universe it probably would have been vastly more popular.
